description: Generates an image from a text prompt with Leonardo Lucid Origin in about 2 seconds. Unlike a plain FLUX route it takes a seed, so the same prompt and seed give you the same image again, plus a negative prompt and your own width and height. Returns a hosted image URL valid for 24 hours; add inline=true to also get the base64. You are only charged if the image is delivered. No API key, no account. $0.02 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

guidance.description: How closely to follow the prompt, 0-20.

height.description: Height in pixels, a multiple of 8 between 256 and 1536. Default 1024.

inline.description: Also return the image as base64. Default false.

negative_prompt.description: What to keep out of the image, up to 1024 characters.

prompt.description: What to draw, up to 2048 characters. English works best.

seed.description: Same prompt and same seed give the same image. Omit it for a new one every time.

steps.description: Diffusion steps, 1-20. More is sharper and slower.

width.description: Width in pixels, a multiple of 8 between 256 and 1536. Default 1024.

name: ai_image_pro
title: Text-to-image with a seed (Leonardo Lucid Origin)
